title: Zeta Function Partial Sum Path Visualization
full_prompt: Write a ManimGL script that visualizes the partial sums of the Riemann Zeta function (or its exponentially regulated version) on the complex plane. The scene should display two complex planes side-by-side: an 's-plane' on the left and an 'out-plane' on the right. A yellow dot representing the complex variable $s$ should be interactive/trackable on the s-plane. On the out-plane, draw a continuous path representing the partial sums $\sum_{n=1}^N n^{-s} e^{-cn}$. Animate the tracker $s$ moving to the first non-trivial zero of the zeta function, and animate the regulator constant $c$ changing from 0 to 0.01, showing how the spiral of partial sums converges or changes shape.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Using ManimCE ValueTracker for complex numbers directly without handling real/imaginary parts, causing type errors.
common_failure_modes.note: ManimGL's ComplexValueTracker natively supports complex numbers, whereas ManimCE's ValueTracker only supports floats.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing mpmath dependency or incorrect zeta zero calculation.
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure mpmath is imported and used correctly to fetch the non-trivial zeros of the Riemann Zeta function.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Using ManimGL-specific syntax like 'always.next_to' or 'make_number_changeable' in a standard Manim Community environment.
common_failure_modes.note: These are shorthand methods unique to the 3b1b/manim (ManimGL) repository.
